The failure rate is concerning at 81%, with [[reachability]]_failed being the worst offender at 33 occurrences. The pen and t-shirt are the worst offenders, each failing 33 times. Failures seem to be clustered on specific items like pens and shirts rather than particular days or times. 

**Suggestion:** Ensure that all items, especially pens and shirts, face forward for easier recognition by ROBI.
